## Scope and stable task IDs
State the API/MOB/ADM/WEB IDs, intended acceptance and explicit exclusions.

## Implementation, tests and evidence
Link source, contracts/migrations, exact commands, environment, outcomes and skips. Distinguish documentation tests from application/provider tests. Do not include secrets or real customer records.

## Documentation checklist
- [ ] Affected service README task register updated truthfully.
- [ ] Root README and generated registers are current.
- [ ] Relevant design/API/security/operations docs updated.
- [ ] Changed real UI captures and provenance included, or a reviewed no-visual-impact reason is recorded below.
- [ ] Local docs checks and affected app tests/build executed, with gaps stated.
- [ ] No live provider activation, production deployment or money movement is bundled without explicit approval.

## Rollout and remaining gates
Document compatibility, rollback, provider/release gates, dependencies and owner. No force push or overwriting concurrent work.
